lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the pectoral fin. The clusters exhibit a higher pixel intensity at their centers, tapering off at the edges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-luminance spots. The spots are positioned at the junctions of these vertical and horizontal tonal alignments, forming a regular 2D grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two continuous horizontal linear features are visible along the dorsal-lateral region. Each feature displays a high-contrast luminance gradient, with higher pixel values on the dorsal aspect and lower pixel values on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains a scattered distribution of approximately 10-15 high-luminance circular blobs of varying sizes, with higher density observed towards the posterior-ventral region of the fin mask.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a gradient of spot sizes, with larger spots at the base transitioning to a high density of significantly smaller, pin-point high-luminance pixels towards the apex.
